description: This file declares the interface IController for a plugin system within the WPEFramework. It defines several pure virtual methods related to system control and configuration management, including persistence, deletion, reboot, environment retrieval, configuration retrieval and setting, and cloning.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling and managing plugin system components, exposing methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment management, configuration management, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource specified by a path.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment information associated with an index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a base callsign under a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
